note: Magic Hour API tool catalog for the state solver. Source of truth: official OpenAPI spec (https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/openapi.json, 'Magic Hour API beta'), docs.magichour.ai models/tool pages, npm magic-hour v0.82.0, PyPI magic-hour v0.86.0, hosted MCP tools/list. category rule: generative = model synthesizes new pixels/audio/text; deterministic = no new content synthesis (analysis, cutout, caption overlay, file ops). The category label is an inference, not a docs field. models holds the selectable engine variant: model enum, else version/mode enum. Every create endpoint also accepts optional 'name'. All jobs are async: create returns {id, credits_charged}; poll GET /v1/{video|image|audio}-projects/{id} until status complete, then use downloads[].url (expires 24h). Inputs are a public URL, a Magic Hour library URL, or a file_path from upload-urls. 'unverified' marks values not confirmed in official docs. failure_modes is an extra field.

tools.name: Image-to-Video
tools.purpose: Animate a still image into a video clip, optionally guided by a prompt and an end frame.

inputs.name: assets.image_file_path
inputs.constraints: file URL or file_path from POST /v1/files/upload-urls; start image

inputs.name: assets.end_image_file_path
inputs.constraints: last frame; not supported by minimax-h3, wan-2.2; veo3.1/veo3.1-lite need duration <= 8s; kling-2.6 end frame 1080p only

inputs.name: end_seconds
inputs.constraints: duration 1-60; allowed values per model (see limits)

inputs.name: audio
inputs.constraints: audio: boolean, default false. Not supported: gemini-omni-1.1, kling-2.6, wan-2.2. Extra credits: kling-3.0, seedance-1.5, veo3.1, veo3.1-lite. Free: ltx-2.5, minimax-h3, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-mini, seedance-2.5, wan-3.0.

output.format: video file via downloads[].url (container unverified; likely mp4)

tools.default_model: default (= kling-3.0 on paid tiers, ltx-2.5 on free tier)

limits.aspect_ratio_note: No aspect_ratio field; output shape follows input image (inferred).
limits.other: Legacy values still accepted: ltx-2, kling-2.5, kling-1.6, seedance, kling-2.5-audio, veo3.1-audio (-audio = base model + audio:true).

tools.cost: Credits/second of output x end_seconds. 360p/480p/720p/1080p/4k: gemini-omni-1.1 48/-/144/192/384; ltx-2.3, ltx-2.5, minimax-h3, wan-2.2 -/24/48/72/-; kling-2.6 -/-/36/72/-; kling-3.0 -/-/48/72/240 (+24 audio at 720p/1080p, +48 at 4k); veo3.1-lite -/-/48/72 (+24 audio); veo3.1 -/-/96/120 (+24 audio); seedance-1.5 -/30/60/90 (audio 2x); seedance-2.0-mini -/96/192; seedance-2.0 -/144/288; seedance-2.5 -/288/576; sora-2 720p 120. Formula: duration x output fps x resolution multiplier. Create response gives an estimate; final value on get-details. Failed jobs refunded.

maintains.property: first frame = input image (subject identity, composition, style at t=0)

mutates.property: adds motion, camera movement and environmental effects over time
subject identity can drift in later frames

failure_modes: Paid default (kling-3.0) does not support 480p.
Unsupported duration/resolution combination per model is rejected (inferred).
Free resolution limited; higher resolutions need paid plan.
